project_info.theme: Low-cost daily sports entertainment pass for World Cup 2026 streaming
project_info.color_palette: White, Viettel Red, Black, Multicolor Sports Stripes

main_subject.detail: A young man in a red shirt lounges on a white sofa in a bright living room, cheering while watching a football match on a tablet, beside huge text promoting a 2,000 VND per day TV360 package.
main_subject.style: Photoreal lifestyle offer poster with airy modern home interior and energetic sports-viewing mood.

items: Top Left: Large red price '2.000Đ/NGÀY' and black line 'DK CUP gửi 1331'.
Top Right: Viettel telecom logo and sweeping multicolor sports stripes descending from the upper-right corner.
Bottom Left: Excited young man on sofa raising a fist while holding a tablet showing a football match.
Bottom Right: Modern living room with coffee table, TV, and clean interior decor.
Center/Background: Bright white apartment environment with sports-offer copy running along the bottom.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Airy home lighting, clean interior whites, dynamic fan excitement, and crisp promo readability.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality sports-viewing offer poster for Viettel TV360. Centerpiece is a young man in a red shirt celebrating on a white sofa while watching football on a tablet in a bright modern living room. Background is a minimal white apartment setting with sweeping multicolor sports stripes from the upper-right. Surrounding elements: giant red price '2.000Đ/NGÀY', line 'DK CUP gửi 1331', Viettel telecom logo, and bottom copy about World Cup 2026, free 4G/5G data, 120+ TV channels, Bundesliga, V.League, and viewing on two devices. Technical style: photoreal sports lifestyle advertising poster, bright commercial daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Young male football viewer reference
assets.usage: Preserve the red shirt, cheering pose, and sofa position.

assets.name: Tablet football-screen reference
assets.usage: Use a small football match image on the tablet display.

assets.name: Multicolor sports stripes
assets.usage: Keep as a strong curved graphic element from the upper-right.

assets.name: TV360 daily-pass offer layout
assets.usage: Preserve the price, SMS command, and bottom sports-copy wording.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve 'World Cup 2026' exactly as the promotional anchor. Keep the living-room scene bright and aspirational, with the person clearly engaged in live football viewing.
